title: AI builds a single wall on the Classic lane map
description: User report (2026-10-14, undead vs undead, hard): on the default Classic lane map (IN left-middle, OUT right-middle) the computer builds one full-height vertical wall and then only extends it; no serpentine forms and it loses by wave ~8. Reproduced: npm run sim:maze -- --rounds 8 --difficulty hard (no seed) shows one 14-tower wall. Root causes: (1) all tuning/baselines (sim:duel-batch, planner baseline tests) used generated endpoint seeds, never the Classic lane map; (2) wall candidates are only straight edge-attached walls; on this geometry a perpendicular wall costs ~14 towers, so a second wall is unaffordable for many rounds. Fix: add cheaper wall shapes the rules allow — diagonal chains of 2x2 towers touching at corners (corner-touching towers block movement, so a 7-tower diagonal spans 14 rows), staggered/zigzag partial walls, walls attached to existing walls — and include the Classic lane map in sim:duel-batch and the planner baseline tests.
acceptance_criteria: Classic lane map, hard, sim:maze: a serpentine with >= 2 turns by round 8 and route cost per wall gold at least as good as the generated-seed median; sim:duel-batch has a classic-lane row meeting the user targets (median 20-30 rounds, 10-14 towers by round 5); existing baseline tests green.

title: Natural path ribbon: masked spline over the path texture instead of square cells

When the wave settles, the dock returns in the state it had (last tab, scroll position).
